title: Finding America: The West
description:
Список возможностей• Behold the sights of the West, all done in a Hidden Object style. 

• Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the West! 

• Pick up fun facts about the region! 

• Comes with wallpapers and a full soundtrack. 

• Maximize your vacation with Unlimited Mode!

Коллекционное издание• 12 more chapters 

• 6 CE-exclusive Hidden Object scenes!

Об игреImmerse yourself in the rich history and culture of the Western United States and discover its hidden treasures in this new hidden object game.

 

Along your journey, you'll encounter fascinating fun facts about the iconic Western locations you visit, from the towering peaks of Yosemite National Park, the beautiful Grand Canyon, and iconic Santa Monica Pier. 

 

With stunning visuals and engaging gameplay, our game is the ultimate Western adventure for players of all ages.
description_short: Explore the West and uncover its hidden gems through the excitement of finding fun objects.
